why: L1b, as measured (receipts/l1.json), found every block loaded, the office digest equal to the planted one, 0 requests leaving and Kar open in 3.15 s, but read 0 elements in all seven block frames: its probe named a frame by the URL it had when DevTools attached, and Chrome attaches to an isolated sandboxed frame before that URL exists, so no frame was named. claims.says: The same seed grows the same office in a browser tab with the network off; every block starts and runs (read inside each block's own frame).
claims.held_if: L1b's steps, unchanged (Chrome headless with its own throwaway profile, the office page from the owner's own origin, the network emulated offline before the seed is chosen, the full seed planted, every block opened from the rail as soon as the one before reported loaded, 1.5 s left for late errors), with the frames named at the end by asking Chrome for every frame target and its URL then.
